name: Alliance Relations
summary: In Orgrimmar, Alliance advances across Kalimdor put the Horde under pressure. Thrall's people send orders to Desolace to purge demons before the Alliance can accuse them of renewed ties to the Burning Legion.

sections.title: A Matter of Perception
sections.body: Alliance scouts and expeditions cross Kalimdor, leaving the Horde in a delicate position. Demonic remnants in central Kalimdor could confirm old suspicions that the orcs and their allies still serve the Burning Legion. With Warchief Thrall's sanction, Keldran oversees the effort from Orgrimmar. They must clear those remnants before hostile Alliance factions use them to justify war.

sections.title: Outpost in the Wastes
sections.body: The orders lead south through the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains and onward into Desolace. Ghost Walker Post stands just north of the vast Kodo Graveyard. Horde agents such as Takata Steelblade watch over these wastes. Rampant centaur tribes and spreading demonic corruption both threaten the region.

sections.title: Pragmatic Alliances
sections.body: Takata Steelblade regards the assignment with grim pragmatism. Clearing the local demons also eases pressure on violent centaur tribes and helps the Horde's resident warlocks. Yet the duty comes first. Removing the Burning Legion's footholds protects the Horde, whatever others gain from the purge.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about the Alliance here?
faq.answer: Alliance forces advancing across Kalimdor could use active demon infestations as proof that the Horde still consorts with the Burning Legion. By purging local demons, the Horde hopes to blunt those accusations.
Keldran is a Horde operative in Orgrimmar who oversees operations against demons that threaten the Horde's standing, with the Warchief's approval.

faq.q: Where is Ghost Walker Post located?
faq.answer: Ghost Walker Post lies in central Desolace, just south of the pass from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains and just north of the Kodo Graveyard.
Takata Steelblade is a Horde soldier at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. The Warchief has tasked him with keeping regional threats, including demons and hostile centaur, in check.

faq.q: Why does Takata mention aiding the centaur?
faq.answer: The centaur claim Desolace as their territory, but cannot contain the growing demon threat. Culling the demons also helps the centaur survive, a compromise Takata accepts for the Horde's security.

faq.q: How do warlocks tie into this mission?
faq.answer: Takata notes with distaste that clearing wild demons and their influence also aids the controversial warlocks who operate within the Horde.

angles.text: The mission reflects Warchief Thrall's effort to legitimize the new Horde and bury the legacy of demonic servitude before hostile neighbors can exploit it.
Soldiers such as Takata Steelblade view dark powers with suspicion, yet operations against wild demons often cross paths with the Horde's pragmatic use of warlocks.
For orcs seeking to honor Thrall's vision of redemption, any lingering hint of demonic taint in Kalimdor threatens their hard-won freedom.
